vendors.name: Obat
vendors.tagline: Devis, factures et suivi de chantier pour les pros du bâtiment
vendors.market_position: Obat is building-trades software from Obat SAS in Nantes, covering quotes, invoices, worksite planning and profitability tracking, with iOS and Android apps and a price library of 30,000 items. Obat says more than 21,000 building professionals use it and that its team has more than 110 people. It handles French e-invoicing through Iopole, which appears on the DGFiP list of registered plateformes agréées.
pros: Built for French building trades, with separate plans for micro-entrepreneurs
Published prices, billed monthly or yearly
E-invoicing included through Iopole, a DGFiP-registered platform
Price library of 30,000 building items
14-day free trial without a card
cons: Plans include one user; extra licences are an unpriced option
Purchasing, profitability and planning need Croissance or above
Website and marketing extras only in the top Booster plan
Product and support are in French
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, per month excl. VAT (HT). Micro-entreprise: Pro €32 monthly or €25 billed yearly, Croissance €52 or €45, Booster €95 or €85. Artisan seul and TPE/PME (1 user included): Pro €49 or €39, Croissance €79 or €69, Booster €129 or €109. Extra licences optional, price not shown.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Obat says every plan complies with the French e-invoicing reform through Iopole, a registered plateforme agréée. Its micro-entreprise plans are meant for sole traders who are not registered for VAT, while artisans with VAT and firms of 2-50 people use the Artisan seul and TPE/PME plans.

vendors.name: Tolteck
vendors.tagline: Devis et factures pour artisans du bâtiment, même sans réseau
vendors.market_position: Tolteck is a quote and invoice app for building-trade artisans from Tolteck SAS, a company created in 2016 that Saint-Gobain acquired in 2017; its registered office is the Tour Saint-Gobain in Courbevoie. It runs on PC, Mac, tablet and smartphone, works without a network connection and includes a works library. It covers devis and factures rather than worksite planning or purchasing.
pros: Works with or without a network connection
One published plan, billed monthly or yearly
E-invoice issuing and receipt included at no extra cost
One-month free trial; 35% off for firms under five years old
Support by phone, chat and email from France
cons: No worksite planning or purchasing modules on the feature list
Users included per subscription not stated on the pricing page
E-invoice receipt depends on a Pennylane integration
Owned by Saint-Gobain, a building-materials group
vendors.typical_pricing: Published: €25/mo excl. VAT (HT) billed monthly, or €19/mo HT billed yearly (€228 a year). One-month free trial; Tolteck offers an extra 35% discount to firms under five years old.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Tolteck says issuing and receiving e-invoices under the French reform is included in its price, with receipt through its Pennylane integration; Pennylane is on the DGFiP list of registered plateformes agréées. Tolteck cites the obligation to receive e-invoices from 1 September 2026 and, for SMEs, artisans and micro-enterprises, to issue them from 1 September 2027.

vendors.name: EBP Bâtiment
vendors.tagline: Devis, factures et chantiers pour le bâtiment, par EBP (groupe Cegid)
vendors.market_position: EBP Bâtiment is the building-trade range of EBP, a French business-software publisher based in Gazeran that joined the Cegid group in July 2024. It comes in three editions (ACTIV, PRO and ELITE) covering quotes, invoices, progress billing, worksite tracking and a mobile app, with PRO and ELITE adding planning, stock and purchasing. EBP integrates the plateforme agréée Shine for French e-invoicing.
pros: Three editions, from 1-user ACTIV to multi-company ELITE
Situations de travaux, progress invoices and métré built in
Plateforme agréée Shine integrated for e-invoicing
Published monthly prices for ACTIV and PRO
Works with the Batiprix and Batichiffrage libraries
cons: Batiprix and Batichiffrage libraries are bought separately from their publishers
Published prices cover one user; multi-user versions are on quote
ELITE is quote-only
Worksite planning, stock and purchasing need PRO or above
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, per month excl. VAT (HT): Bâtiment ACTIV €53 (1 user), Bâtiment PRO €82 (1 user, 3 companies). ELITE and multi-user versions (ACTIV up to 4 users, PRO up to 12) on quote. Works-price libraries cost extra.
vendors.fr_specific_note: EBP says its building range complies with the French e-invoicing reform through the integrated plateforme agréée Shine, which is on the DGFiP list of registered platforms. If you price from a works library, budget separately for Batiprix or Batichiffrage, which EBP connects to but does not supply.

vendors.name: Batappli
vendors.tagline: Devis, factures et chantiers pour le BTP, avec la bibliothèque Batichiffrage
vendors.market_position: Batappli is building-trade software published by Systemlog SAS, based in the Montpellier area and part of the Isagri group since 2018. It covers quotes, invoices, progress billing, deposits, site management and a mobile app, with the Batichiffrage works library built in. Batappli says 5,000 companies and 9,000 users work with it across mainland France, the overseas territories and French-speaking Europe.
pros: Batichiffrage works library built in
Published per-user prices, monthly or yearly
E-invoicing included free through Cecurity, a registered plateforme agréée
Progress billing (situations de travaux) and deposits handled
10-day free trial
cons: Prices are per user; each extra user costs more
Devis plan includes one Batichiffrage lot; extra lots cost more
Stock, site and supplier management need the Artisan plan
General terms allow tacit annual renewal with 3 months' notice on committed contracts
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, excl. VAT (HT), 1 user included: Batappli Devis €39/mo or €429/yr; Batappli Artisan €79/mo or €869/yr. Extra user €19/mo or €209/yr. Extra Batichiffrage lots €9/mo or €99/yr. 10-day free trial.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Batappli says e-invoicing is included free for all customers through eFacture by Cecurity (Isagri group), which the DGFiP registered as a plateforme agréée on 18 December 2025. Batappli also says its Batichiffrage items are priced in line with the DTU building standards.

vendors.name: Mediabat
vendors.tagline: Devis, factures, métré et suivi de chantier pour le BTP
vendors.market_position: Mediabat is building-trade software from Mediabat SARL, a company created in 2004 and based in Montpellier. It covers quotes and invoices, works libraries, métré with ScanPlan, progress billing, worksite tracking, maintenance contracts and a mobile app, for trades from masonry to electrical and plumbing. Mediabat says thousands of artisans and building firms have used its software for more than 30 years.
pros: Published monthly prices, with or without commitment
Quotes, invoices, progress billing and worksite tracking in one tool
Métré with ScanPlan and trade libraries
15-day free trial
Team based in France
cons: Commitment length for the cheaper plans not stated on the pricing page
Extra users cost €15/mo each; email and SMS sends are paid
Job management (gestion des affaires) is an option on PRO
Site does not name its e-invoicing platform
vendors.typical_pricing: Published per month (the page does not say HT or TTC): with commitment, PRO €37 or VIP €67 (adds help writing quotes and job management); without commitment, PRO €47 with a 4-month minimum. Extra user €15/mo. 15-day free trial.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Mediabat lists the anti-fraud VAT law, the mandatory waste mentions on building quotes and e-invoicing among the French rules its software covers, but its site does not name the plateforme agréée it uses. Ask which platform handles e-invoice receipt and issuing before you sign.

vendors.name: Vertuoza
vendors.tagline: Gestion de chantier tout-en-un, avec devis dictés à la voix par IA
vendors.market_position: Vertuoza is construction-management software from a company based in Nivelles, Belgium, which says it built the tool in-house from 2015, opened it to the sector in 2020 and now serves five countries including France. It covers quotes, invoicing, worksite planning and profitability, stock, HR and CRM, with VertuoAI for voice-dictated quotes. Vertuoza says it has 13,000 users and has raised €11.2 million from investors including XAnge.
pros: Quotes, invoicing, worksite, stock, HR and CRM in one tool
Voice-dictated quotes with VertuoAI
Deposits, progress invoices, prorata and retentions handled
E-invoicing included in every pack, per Vertuoza
Unlimited support and updates in every pack
cons: No public prices; pricing after a demo
Belgian company with no French office named on its site
French e-invoicing platform partner not named
Stock management only in the top Expert+ pack
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices. Four packs (PRO, PRO+, Expert, Expert+); Vertuoza says the price depends on the company's needs.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Vertuoza says its invoices are sent and received in the format the French e-invoicing law requires through its integration with the official network, and that e-invoicing is in every pack. It does not name its plateforme agréée and is not on the DGFiP list itself, so ask which platform it uses and get a written quote.

vendors.name: Organilog
vendors.tagline: Gestion d'interventions, planning et maintenance pour les métiers de terrain
vendors.market_position: Organilog is field-service software published by SARL Adalgo, a company founded in 2013 in Pontchâteau (Loire-Atlantique). It is built around interventions, team planning, maintenance contracts and an offline-capable mobile app, with quotes, invoicing, stock and CRM on higher plans. It targets service trades such as HVAC, plumbing, building, maintenance, landscaping and cleaning; Organilog says more than 1,600 companies use it.
pros: Free Basique plan to start
Published per-user prices
Interventions, planning, maintenance contracts and an offline mobile app
Chorus Pro connector and e-invoice issuing from the Business plan
cons: Per-user pricing grows with team size
Invoicing needs Business; e-invoice receipt and progress invoices need Premium
Premium plans are billed yearly
Free plan has limited features, no support and a 72-hour archive
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, per user per month (the page does not say HT or TTC): Basique free (limited); Pro €19; Business €35; Premium €59 and Premium + Carte €64, both on yearly billing.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Organilog says it is compatible with French and Belgian e-invoicing, with issuing from the Business plan and receiving only in Premium, and Business and above include a Chorus Pro connector for public-sector clients. It does not name its plateforme agréée and is not on the DGFiP list itself, so ask which platform it uses.

vendors.name: Axonaut
vendors.tagline: Gestion d'entreprise tout-en-un : devis, factures, CRM et trésorerie
vendors.market_position: Axonaut is general business-management software for small French businesses from Digitica SAS, based in the Toulouse area, covering quotes and invoices, CRM, purchases, cash-flow forecasting, projects, stock and HR, plus a professional account and cards. It is not specific to building trades. Axonaut says more than 189,000 users rely on it, and it is on the DGFiP list of registered plateformes agréées for e-invoicing.
pros: One price with all features included
Itself a registered plateforme agréée; e-invoicing at no extra cost
CRM, cash-flow forecasting and invoicing in one tool
Monthly billing without commitment; 15-day free trial
cons: Not built specifically for building trades
Base price includes one user; each extra user €29.99/mo HT
Online payments, e-signature and postal sending can cost extra
Entry price of €97/mo HT, above quote-only tools such as Tolteck (€25/mo HT)
vendors.typical_pricing: Published: €97/mo excl. VAT (HT) including 1 user, plus €29.99/mo HT per extra user. Monthly with no commitment; 10% off on a 1-year commitment and 20% off on 2 years. 15-day free trial.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Axonaut is itself on the DGFiP list of registered plateformes agréées (registration issued 8 January 2026), and it says e-invoicing is included at no extra cost. Its feature list does not mention building-specific tools such as works-price libraries, so check it covers your quoting needs.

vendors.name: Habitatpresto
vendors.tagline: Mise en relation entre particuliers et professionnels de la rénovation
vendors.market_position: Habitatpresto is a Paris-based platform, run by Habitatpresto SAS since 2005, that matches homeowners' renovation projects with building professionals. Homeowners describe a project and receive up to five quotes; Habitatpresto's terms say its only income is an annual fee paid by member professionals, with no commission on the work. It says it has 5,000 professionals and has served 300,000 homeowners.
pros: No commission on work won, per its terms
Unlimited project requests in your trade and area, per Habitatpresto
Projects are screened before they are sent, per Habitatpresto
Alerts by SMS, email and mobile app
cons: No public prices for the annual membership
Each request can go to up to five professionals
Ranking depends partly on payment, per its referencing charter
Charter describes no checks on the information professionals declare
vendors.typical_pricing: Annual membership fee paid by professionals; no public prices. No commission on work, per Habitatpresto's terms.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Habitatpresto's referencing charter says paying members rank higher and that ratings, review counts, uploaded documents and declared labels also affect ranking. Ask for the annual fee, the commitment length and the number of requests in your trade and area before you sign.

vendors.name: Quotatis
vendors.tagline: Forfaits de pose et travaux réalisés par un réseau d'artisans
vendors.market_position: Quotatis is a French home-improvement services company (Quotatis Groupe, registered in Paris since 1999) whose website now presents fixed-price installation packages (forfaits de pose). A 2019 La Poste article described it as part of ADEO, the group behind Leroy Merlin, running an artisan network that carried out installation services sold to Leroy Merlin customers at predefined package prices. Its terms and pay for partner artisans are not public.
pros: Linked to the ADEO group (Leroy Merlin), per a 2019 La Poste article
Jobs come as predefined installation packages, with no quote to write
Company registered since 1999 and still active
cons: No published terms, fees or pay rates for partner artisans
Package prices are set per type of work, not by the artisan, per the 2019 report
Professional sign-up page returned an error on 30 September 2026
vendors.typical_pricing: No public prices or terms for professionals. A 2019 report describes customers paying predefined package prices by type of work.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Quotatis's public site could not be read in detail and its professional sign-up page returned an error on 30 September 2026. Contact Quotatis directly to confirm whether it is recruiting artisans in your area and on what terms (package rates, payment timing, insurance requirements).

vendors.name: Travaux.com
vendors.tagline: French home-services marketplace owned by Angi Inc.
vendors.market_position: Travaux.com is a French home-services marketplace that puts homeowners in touch with trades professionals. The operating company, Travaux.com, has been registered in Aix-en-Provence since 2006, and US company Angi Inc. names Travaux as its French marketplace in its 2025 annual report. Travaux.com says signing up is free, while answering quote requests needs a paid subscription sized by the number of requests.
pros: Established French company, registered in Aix-en-Provence since 2006
Backed by Angi Inc., which runs similar marketplaces in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands and Canada
Free sign-up with no commitment, per Travaux.com
Still owned and operated by Angi as of its Q2 2026 filing
cons: Answering quote requests needs a paid subscription
Subscription prices not published on pages we could read
Lead terms (exclusive or shared, refunds) not confirmed
Owned by US company Angi Inc., not an independent French firm
vendors.typical_pricing: Free sign-up; answering quote requests needs a paid subscription priced on the number of requests you want to answer. No public prices found.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Travaux.com is run by a French company in Aix-en-Provence and owned by Angi Inc. Sign-up is free, but answering requests needs a paid subscription: before you pay, ask the price per request band, whether each request goes to several artisans, and the cancellation terms, then track cost per job won.

vendors.name: StarOfService
vendors.tagline: Local-services marketplace, home trades included, with published subscription plans for pros
vendors.market_position: StarOfService is a local-services marketplace operated by StarOfService SAS in Paris, covering home trades alongside weddings, events, wellness and lessons, with sister sites in Germany, Spain, Italy, Poland and the UK. It says more than 180,000 professionals are listed in France. Its terms, updated 31 March 2026, describe subscription plans priced by service category plus a monthly service fee, rather than pay-per-lead.
pros: Free online profile for professionals, per its pro page
Prices published in its terms of service
Pros can browse and filter client requests
Plan sizes from up to 10 interactions to unlimited
cons: Generalist: building trades sit beside weddings, events, wellness and lessons
59 € HT monthly service fee on top of the subscription
Auto-renewing plans with 15 days' notice and a 15 USD cancellation fee
Plan price depends on your service category
vendors.typical_pricing: Published in its terms (updated 31/03/2026): subscription price varies by service category. Indépendant (up to 10 interactions) €29-€99; Professionnel (up to 100) €99-€349; Entreprise (unlimited) €849-€2,990; billed monthly, quarterly or annually. Plus a €59 HT monthly service fee, a €49 yearly visibility fee and a €29 HT admin fee.
vendors.fr_specific_note: A generalist marketplace, so building work competes for attention with many other categories. Read the terms before you sign: besides the subscription, StarOfService charges a €59 HT monthly service fee and a €49 yearly visibility fee, plans renew automatically, and cancelling needs 15 days' notice and costs 15 USD.

vendors.name: PayFit
vendors.tagline: Payroll and HR service for small firms with published prices; BTP agreements not yet supported
vendors.market_position: PayFit is a Paris-based payroll and HR service for small and mid-sized firms, covering payslips, DSN social declarations, leave, time tracking and expense reports. It says 22,000 companies use it and that 200 payroll and HR experts work alongside its software and AI tools. Its own FAQ states that some very specific collective agreements, including BTP, are not yet integrated.
pros: Published monthly prices with no commitment
Payslips, DSN declarations and leave management included
PayFit says 200 payroll and HR experts support customers
Integrations with Qonto, Swile, Alan, Pennylane and others
cons: BTP collective agreements not yet integrated, per PayFit
Standard plans add a €49 monthly subscription to the per-employee fee
Starter price is only for companies running their first payroll, and PayFit shows it as an offer ending 31 October 2026
Firms with 10 or more employees are steered to a demo
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, HT, monthly, no commitment: Starter €26 per employee per month (first payroll only; offer for new customers until 31 October 2026); Paie €20 per employee per month + €49 monthly subscription; Paie avancée €27 + €49; RH+ €30 + €49. Expense reports add-on €3 per employee per month.
vendors.fr_specific_note: PayFit's own site says BTP collective agreements are not yet integrated, and its list of supported agreements has no building or public-works one. A building firm under the BTP conventions (ouvriers, ETAM, cadres, CIBTP leave funds) should get written confirmation from PayFit before switching.

vendors.name: Silae
vendors.tagline: Payroll software deployed through accounting firms and integrators; Cegid combination announced
vendors.market_position: Silae is a French payroll and HR software publisher whose products (mySilae Paie, Entreprise, BI, Santé and others) are deployed and maintained by about 6,000 partner accounting firms and integrators rather than sold direct. Silae says it produces 8 million payslips a month, has 900 collective agreements integrated, and that its partners serve about one million companies. On 9 September 2026 Silae and Cegid, both majority-owned by Silver Lake, announced a plan to combine, subject to works-council consultation and regulatory approval, with completion expected in the first half of 2027.
pros: Silae says 900 collective agreements are integrated
Deployed and maintained by certified partner firms
Range covers payroll, HR, reporting, health cover and HR contracts
8 million payslips a month, per Silae
cons: Not sold direct: you go through an accounting firm or integrator
No public prices; each partner sets its own fees
BTP-specific handling not detailed on Silae's public site
Combination with Cegid pending, expected in the first half of 2027
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices. Sold through partner accounting firms and integrators, which set their own fees.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Silae is reached through your expert-comptable or an integrator, so ask your firm whether it uses Silae and what it charges. Silae says 900 collective agreements are integrated; ask the firm to confirm your BTP convention and CIBTP leave-fund declarations are handled. Silae and Cegid announced a planned combination on 9 September 2026.

vendors.name: EBP Paie
vendors.tagline: Payroll software or outsourced payroll from EBP, part of the Cegid group
vendors.market_position: EBP Paie is the payroll offer of EBP, a French management-software publisher based in Gazeran (Yvelines) that joined the Cegid group in July 2024. It comes as self-managed software (payslips, DSN filing, collective-agreement updates) or as an outsourced service with a dedicated payroll manager. EBP also sells EBP Devis Facture Bâtiment for building firms and EBP Comptabilité for accounting.
pros: Choice of self-managed software or outsourced payroll
DSN filing and collective-agreement updates included, per EBP
Same publisher as EBP Devis Facture Bâtiment and EBP Comptabilité
EBP says outsourced payslips are delivered in 48-72 hours
cons: Quote-based; no public prices
No BTP-specific payroll features described on the payroll page
Owner Cegid plans to combine with Silae, so the group is changing
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based ("Sur devis"); no public prices for either the self-managed or outsourced offer.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Worth a look if you already use EBP Devis Facture Bâtiment or EBP Comptabilité and want one publisher. EBP's payroll page does not describe BTP-specific handling such as CIBTP leave funds or intempéries, so ask for it in writing with the quote.

vendors.name: Sage Paie
vendors.tagline: Sage Business Cloud Paie: online payroll for small firms from the UK-based Sage group
vendors.market_position: Sage Business Cloud Paie is the online payroll software of Sage, whose parent company, The Sage Group plc, is registered in Newcastle upon Tyne, UK. Sage says it handles DSN, withholding tax and collective agreements with automatic regulatory updates, and recommends it as the replacement for Ciel Paye, which no longer gets legal updates. Larger firms are offered Sage 100 Paie & RH.
pros: Published entry price
DSN, withholding tax and collective agreements updated automatically, per Sage
Payslips delivered to employees' digital safe
Migration path for Ciel Paye users
cons: Monthly company fee on top of the per-employee price
BTP-specific features not described on the pages found
Data analysis add-on charged separately
vendors.typical_pricing: Published by Sage: the Sage Business Cloud Paie payroll module starts at €15.75 HT a month and rises with the number of employees (Sage's online configurator showed €25.20 HT a month for its default setup on 2026-09-30). Options are priced separately, for example digital payslip delivery from €0.66 HT per payslip a month and absence planning from €1.70 HT per employee a month.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Sage Business Cloud Paie is Sage's online payroll for small French firms and the route Sage recommends for Ciel Paye users. The Sage pages we found do not describe BTP-specific items such as CIBTP leave funds or intempéries, so confirm them with Sage or your accountant before switching.

vendors.name: SMABTP
vendors.tagline: Construction mutual insurer since 1859: décennale, liability and business cover for building firms
vendors.market_position: SMABTP (Société mutuelle d'assurance du bâtiment et des travaux publics) is a Paris-based mutual insurer in Groupe SMA, founded in 1859 by a Paris masonry contractors' association; it says it wrote the first décennale contract in 1923. Its artisan décennale contract includes the ten-year liability plus civil liability, works-damage cover, legal protection and personal accident cover, and it offers an online quote. Premiums are not published and depend on trade, turnover, staff, company age, qualifications and claims history.
pros: Mutual insurer focused on construction since 1859
Décennale bundled with civil liability, works damage and legal protection
Online décennale quote tool
Also insures vehicles, premises, health and prévoyance for artisans
Attestations available from the client area
cons: No published prices
Premium depends on trade, turnover, staff, company age and claims history
Discount terms for new or claim-free firms not published
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices (online quote available).
vendors.fr_specific_note: SMABTP reminds builders that décennale cover is required from the first day of activity. It offers an online quote but publishes no prices, so get its quote alongside others and compare the activities covered, the excess and the attestation wording, not just the premium.

vendors.name: April Construction
vendors.tagline: Décennale through broker APRIL Partenaires, with published starting prices per trade
vendors.market_position: APRIL Construction is the building-trades décennale offer (the PROBAT range) of APRIL Partenaires, a registered insurance intermediary in Fougères that places cover with partner insurers it does not name. It allows up to 10 insurable activities on one contract and publishes 'from' prices per trade, each tied to a stated profile. The APRIL group describes itself as a wholesale insurance broker and has been controlled by the investment firm KKR since 2023, according to press reports.
pros: Publishes starting prices per trade, with the profile used
Up to 10 insurable activities on one contract
Digital attestation, including a phone wallet format
Also offers RC pro, multirisk, health and prévoyance cover
cons: Starting prices assume a specific profile, such as a new business with €30,000 turnover
Broker: the insurer carrying the risk is not named on the page
Final price needs a quote; APRIL says premiums run from €700 to over €5,000 a year
Photovoltaic and design trades start far higher (€418 and €369 a month)
vendors.typical_pricing: Published 'from' prices, TTC per month, each for a stated profile: electrician €69 (new business, €30,000 turnover); painter or plasterer €72 (new business, €30,000 turnover, €2,000 excess); IRVE charger installer €69; building design professions €369; photovoltaic installer €418. APRIL says annual premiums range from €700 to over €5,000.
vendors.fr_specific_note: APRIL's published 'from' prices are a useful first benchmark for décennale, but each is for one profile (for example a new electrician with €30,000 turnover), so get a quote for your own figures. Ask which insurer carries the policy and check that every activity you do is listed on the attestation.

vendors.name: Orus
vendors.tagline: Online décennale through broker Orus: quote in minutes, attestation in 24 hours
vendors.market_position: Orus is an insurance broker based in Saint-Mandé that sells décennale, RC pro, multirisk, health and prévoyance cover online to small businesses. Its décennale covers more than 100 building trades, bundles the ten-year liability with professional liability and a proper-functioning guarantee, and allows up to 5 activities per contract. Orus lists Hiscox, AIG and Munich Re as the companies guaranteeing its contracts and says it has more than 60,000 policyholders.
pros: Online quote in about 3 minutes and attestation in 24 hours, per Orus
Décennale bundles RC pro and a proper-functioning guarantee
More than 100 building trades covered, up to 5 activities per contract
Published starting price, with up to 20% off for firms under 6 months old
cons: Broker, not the insurer: cover is carried by partner insurers
Starting price's profile and tax basis not stated
Needs a year of recent experience or a relevant diploma
Limit of 5 activities per contract
vendors.typical_pricing: Published: décennale from €69 per month (profile and HT/TTC basis not stated); up to 20% off for companies under 6 months old. Final price by online quote, depending on trade, turnover, experience, claims history and excess (€500 or €1,000).
vendors.fr_specific_note: Orus quotes décennale online in minutes and says attestations are issued within 24 hours, which helps if a site start is waiting on your certificate. It is a broker, so ask which insurer carries your policy, and check that all your activities (up to 5 per contract) appear on the attestation.

vendors.name: AXA (BATISSUR)
vendors.tagline: Assurance décennale et responsabilité civile BTP (contrat BATISSUR Concept)
vendors.market_position: AXA France sells BATISSUR Concept, a construction insurance contract for building professionals. AXA says it combines responsabilité civile décennale, cover for damage during the works, general liability before and after reception and cover for Travaux Non Constitutifs d'Ouvrage (TNCO), including when the firm works as a subcontractor. AXA France is part of the AXA group, which states it has more than 92 million clients in 52 countries.
pros: Décennale, damage during works and general liability in one contract, per AXA
Covers non-structural work (TNCO) as well
Applies when you work as a subcontractor, per AXA
Quote request online or through a local AXA agent
cons: No public prices: a quote is needed
Cover applies within the contract's terms and conditions, so check the declared activities
Multirisque Pro (premises and equipment) is a separate AXA product
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Décennale cover is compulsory for French building work, and the insurance certificate must be attached to your devis and invoice. AXA's BATISSUR Concept is one way to get it through a mainstream insurer with a local agent network; compare the declared activities, cover limits and deductibles with other décennale quotes before signing.

vendors.name: MAAF Pro
vendors.tagline: Assureur mutualiste des artisans (groupe Covéa), avec une offre décennale
vendors.market_position: MAAF is a French mutual insurer founded in 1950 in Niort and one of the three French brands of the Covéa group, with MMA and GMF. Covéa describes MAAF as a mutual insurer without intermediaries and the historic insurer of artisans, covering both private and professional lines. CAPEB, the artisan building trades federation, lists MAAF as a partner offering cover for premises, equipment, professional vehicles and responsabilité civile décennale.
pros: French mutual insurer, part of the Covéa group
Historic insurer of artisans, per Covéa
Décennale plus premises, equipment and vehicle cover, per CAPEB
Pro and personal insurance from one insurer
cons: No public prices confirmed: a quote is needed
Sells directly, so there is no broker comparing insurers for you
Décennale product details could not be checked on MAAF's own site
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices confirmed.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Convenient if you want professional and personal cover from one French mutual. Décennale insurance is compulsory for building work, so check that every activity you carry out is named on the MAAF certificate and compare the cover limits and deductibles with other décennale quotes.

vendors.name: Facturation électronique (e-invoicing)
vendors.tagline: Facturation électronique obligatoire via une plateforme agréée par l'État
vendors.market_position: Since 1 September 2026 every French business, micro-entrepreneurs included, must be able to receive B2B invoices electronically through a plateforme agréée, a private company registered by the State (CGI art. 289 bis). Large companies and ETI must also issue e-invoices and send transaction data (e-reporting) from that date; PME, TPE and micro-entreprises, which covers most artisans, follow by 1 September 2027. The State runs the national directory but no free public invoicing platform, and DGFiP says more than ten of the 150 approved platforms offered free or no-extra-cost services on 1 August 2026.
pros: One national framework with an official list of approved platforms
Free or no-extra-cost platform offers exist, per DGFiP
No sanctions in 2026, per DGFiP, while businesses adapt
Free DGFiP support line (0806 807 807) and a practical guide
cons: Receiving e-invoices is compulsory for all businesses since 1 September 2026
Artisans must issue e-invoices by 1 September 2027
A PDF sent by email is not an e-invoice: 34 structured data items are required
Fines per invoice apply after the transition (CGI art. 1737)
vendors.typical_pricing: No government fee; the cost depends on the approved platform you choose, and DGFiP says some offer free services.
vendors.fr_specific_note: You must already have a plateforme agréée set up to receive supplier invoices, and your quoting and invoicing software must issue compliant e-invoices through an approved platform by September 2027. Check that your software is on, or connected to, a platform on the DGFiP list; see our facturation électronique guide.

vendors.name: Assurance décennale (Loi Spinetta)
vendors.tagline: Assurance responsabilité civile décennale, obligatoire avant le début des travaux
vendors.market_position: Constructors bound to the owner by a contract, including artisans, must hold responsabilité civile décennale insurance under the Code des assurances (L241-1) and take it out before work starts. It covers, for 10 years from reception, damage that compromises the solidity of the work or makes it unfit for its purpose, including equipment that cannot be separated from the building, on new builds and on work on existing buildings depending on its scale. Building without it is punishable by 6 months' imprisonment and/or a fine of 75,000 euros, per service-public.fr.
pros: Protects clients for 10 years after reception
Covers new builds and significant work on existing buildings
Certificate on every devis and invoice shows clients you are insured
Clear legal basis in the Code des assurances and Code civil
cons: Up to 6 months' imprisonment and/or a 75,000 euro fine if uninsured
Must be in place before work starts
The certificate must be attached to every devis and invoice
No official price: premiums are set by each insurer
vendors.typical_pricing: No official fee; insurers set premiums on quote.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Get décennale cover before you start any building work and give the client your insurance certificate before the site opens; it must also be attached to your devis and invoice. Subcontractors are outside the décennale scope under service-public.fr's guidance but remain liable to the main contractor.

vendors.name: RGE (Reconnu Garant de l’Environnement)
vendors.tagline: Label qualité exigé pour que vos clients obtiennent les aides à la rénovation énergétique
vendors.market_position: RGE (Reconnu Garant de l'Environnement) is a label for energy-renovation professionals, awarded by approved bodies such as Qualibat, Qualit'EnR, Qualifelec, Certibat and Cerqual. It is not a licence to work, but the French ecology ministry says clients can only get MaPrimeRénov', the éco-PTZ, CEE energy-saving bonuses, the SME energy-renovation tax credit or solar buyback rates if the work is done by an RGE professional. The label is valid for 4 years, with annual monitoring and worksite audits.
pros: Lets clients claim MaPrimeRénov', CEE, the éco-PTZ and Anah aid
Listed in the France Rénov' directory of RGE professionals
Several approved bodies award it
Worksite audits give clients an independent quality check
cons: Fees for instruction, the annual certificate and each site audit
Training (Feebat) and a technical referent required at Qualibat
At least one worksite audited within 24 months at Qualibat
Valid 4 years, with annual monitoring to keep it
vendors.typical_pricing: Set by each qualification body. Example, Qualibat 2026 (excl. VAT): 257.50 euros initial instruction per activity, 44.17 euros for the RGE mention, 330 euros per RGE site audit and an annual certificate from 97.50 euros for firms of up to 5 people.
vendors.fr_specific_note: If you do energy-renovation work for homeowners, such as insulation or heat pumps, clients who want MaPrimeRénov', CEE or an éco-PTZ need an RGE installer. Trade press reported in June 2026 that a new arrêté changes access to the label, so check the current requirements with your qualification body before applying.

vendors.name: TVA bâtiment (20 / 10 / 5,5 %)
vendors.tagline: TVA à taux multiples : 20 % normal, 10 % amélioration, 5,5 % rénovation énergétique
vendors.market_position: French building work on homes uses three VAT rates: 20% standard, 10% for improvement, transformation, fitting-out and maintenance, and 5.5% for energy-renovation work. The reduced rates apply only to dwellings completed more than two years ago and not to work that amounts to producing a new building. Since 1 March 2025, supplying or installing boilers that can burn fossil fuels is taxed at 20%, and the client certifies eligibility through a mention on the devis or invoice instead of a separate attestation, per impots.gouv.fr.
pros: Reduced rates lower the price for homeowner clients
No separate attestation since March 2025: a mention on the devis or invoice is enough
Official guidance on impots.gouv.fr, updated March 2026
Maintenance of existing boilers stays at 10%
cons: Rate depends on the type of work, so one quote can carry several rates
Only for dwellings completed more than two years ago
Fossil-fuel boilers taxed at 20% since 1 March 2025
Equipment bought by the client stays at 20%; only the fitting gets the reduced rate
vendors.typical_pricing: No fee (tax rules): 20%, 10% or 5.5% VAT depending on the work.
vendors.fr_specific_note: Your quoting software should let you set the VAT rate per line (20%, 10% or 5.5%) and add the client's eligibility mention to the devis or invoice, which has replaced the separate attestation since 1 March 2025.

vendors.name: URSSAF & régime micro-entrepreneur
vendors.tagline: Cotisations sociales et régime micro-entrepreneur (auto-entrepreneur)
vendors.market_position: Urssaf collects social contributions from the self-employed. Under the micro-entrepreneur regime, contributions are a percentage of declared turnover (21.2% for commercial or artisanal services and 12.3% for sales in 2026), declared online to Urssaf monthly or quarterly, and nothing is due when turnover is zero. The regime applies up to 83,600 euros of turnover for services and 203,100 euros for sales, and VAT franchise is a separate threshold (37,500 euros for services in 2026), per service-public.fr.
pros: Contributions scale with turnover: nothing due on zero turnover
Simple monthly or quarterly online declaration to Urssaf
No VAT to charge below the franchise threshold
One year above the ceiling does not end the regime
cons: Turnover ceiling of 83,600 euros for services (2026)
VAT franchise for services ends above 37,500 euros (immediately above 41,250 euros)
Franchise invoices must carry the 'TVA non applicable - article 293 B du CGI' mention
21.2% of turnover for artisanal services, with no deduction for costs
vendors.typical_pricing: Registration of a micro-entreprise is free; contributions are a percentage of turnover (2026: 21.2% for commercial or artisanal services, 12.3% for sales).
vendors.fr_specific_note: If you work as a micro-entrepreneur, your invoicing software must handle VAT franchise (with the 'TVA non applicable - article 293 B du CGI' mention) and switch to charging VAT once you pass the franchise threshold, which for services is 37,500 euros in 2026, well below the 83,600 euro micro ceiling.

vendors.name: Immatriculation CMA (guichet unique / RNE)
vendors.tagline: Immatriculation de l'entreprise artisanale au RNE via le guichet des formalités des entreprises
vendors.market_position: An artisan business registers online through the Guichet des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, run by INPI), which enters it on the Registre national des entreprises (RNE) and returns an attestation with its SIREN and APE code from INSEE. Registration is free for a micro-entreprise and costs 45 euros for an entreprise individuelle with an artisanal activity, per service-public.fr. The Chambre de métiers et de l'artisanat (CMA) is the artisans' contact for advice, and artisan status (qualité d'artisan) requires a listed craft activity, a professional qualification and fewer than 11 employees.
pros: One online portal for all registration formalities
Free for a micro-entreprise; 45 euros for an entreprise individuelle
Gives your SIREN and APE code
CMA advisers help with the formalities
cons: Must be filed no later than 15 days after you start trading
Regulated building trades need a qualification (diploma or 3 years' experience)
Firms with 11 or more employees also go on the RCS
Sociétés also pay for a legal announcement
vendors.typical_pricing: Free for a micro-entreprise; 45 euros for an entreprise individuelle with an artisanal activity (15 euros if already on the RCS).
vendors.fr_specific_note: Register through formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr up to one month before or within 15 days after you start. For regulated building trades, have your CAP/BEP, equivalent RNCP title or proof of three years' experience ready, as artisan status depends on it; the CMA can advise on the formalities.

vendors.name: Qualification professionnelle (Code de l’artisanat)
vendors.tagline: Diplôme ou 3 ans d'expérience pour les métiers du bâtiment réglementés
vendors.market_position: Under the Code de l'artisanat (art. L121-1), building construction, maintenance and repair, work on water, gas, heating and electrical installations, and chimney sweeping may only be carried out by a professionally qualified person or under that person's effective and permanent control. The qualification is a CAP, BEP or BP, an equivalent RNCP title, or three years' experience in the trade, per service-public.fr. The qualified person can be the owner or an employee who controls the work.
pros: Diploma or 3 years' experience: two routes to qualify
A qualified employee can cover the business if the owner is not
Clear legal basis in the Code de l'artisanat (L121-1)
Also a condition for artisan status (qualité d'artisan)
cons: Compulsory for regulated building trades
Experience route needs documentary proof
7,500 euro fine for plumbing without the qualification, per service-public.fr
The qualified person must control the work effectively and permanently
vendors.typical_pricing: No fee: a legal condition proven with a diploma or evidence of experience.
vendors.fr_specific_note: For regulated building trades such as plumbing, heating or electrical installation, you or an employee who effectively and permanently controls the work must hold a CAP, BEP or BP (or equivalent RNCP title) or prove three years' experience in the trade in France, the EU or the EEA.

vendors.name: Qualibat
vendors.tagline: Qualification et certification des entreprises du bâtiment, dont la mention RGE
vendors.market_position: Qualibat is a French qualification and certification body for building firms, founded in 1949 as an association loi 1901. It says it has qualified 53,000 companies, offers more than 320 qualifications and has 35 local agencies. Qualification is voluntary, but Qualibat is one of the bodies approved to award the RGE mention that homeowners need to claim energy-renovation aid.
pros: Recognised qualification checked by an independent body
Can add the RGE mention for energy-renovation aid
Published fee grid
Public directory where clients can find qualified firms
cons: Voluntary: not a legal requirement to trade
Instruction, annual certificate and audit fees
RGE needs Feebat training and a site audit within 24 months
Renewal needed: trade qualifications run for 4 years
vendors.typical_pricing: Published fees, 2026 (excl. VAT): 257.50 euros initial instruction per activity; annual certificate from 97.50 euros (up to 5 people) to 1,435 euros; RGE mention 44.17 euros; RGE site audit 330 euros. Qualibat's example: about 250 euros a year for a 5-employee masonry firm.
vendors.fr_specific_note: A Qualibat qualification is voluntary, but it lets clients check your competence in a public directory and is a route to the RGE mention, which your homeowner clients need for MaPrimeRénov', CEE or éco-PTZ funding.
